papers/tnpsc-prosecutor-general-2026.title: TNPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor Grade-II – 2026
papers/tnpsc-prosecutor-general-2026.note: Extracted from the uploaded APPGr-II/2026 question booklet. Questions 1–100 cover General Studies and Aptitude & Mental Ability; Questions 101–200 cover Law. Answer is a zero-based option index (A=0, B=1, C=2, D=3), transcribed from visible black ticks in the scanned pages. The booklet states that the English version is final. Where OCR could not reliably recover option wording, explicit placeholders are used rather than invented text.
